description: EVM-007 AC7 (ADR-0018 "Gdzie żyją sekrety"; architect 14; SR-INFRA-05): the files of /etc/evia/secrets (0700, files 0600 root) each service receives as a tmpfs copy in /run/evia/secrets/<service>/ (0400, owned by its UID), written by evia-secrets (secrets.sh) from deploy.sh and at boot from evia-secrets.service (before Docker). The start is refused when a file is missing or has another owner or mode. The migrator password reaches migrate only, the PostgreSQL superuser password postgres only (uid 999 of the image). EVM-084: the S3 keys are provided by hand in the IaC session (init-secrets does not generate them): the media key reaches api only (the worker gets its own key with its story), the deletion-register key worker only, the pgBackRest cipher password and the backup-writer key postgres only; EVM-085: the Grafana write token (an access policy with the write scopes only, with an expiry date) is provided by hand and reaches alloy only; the restore-test token and the restore keys are root-only files of systemd units and in no container. Installed in the IaC session at /etc/evia/deploy-agent/secrets.manifest.json.
